title: Parathyroid scan
description: A parathyroid scan locates overactive parathyroid glands that control calcium levels in your body. During this outpatient test, you'll receive a small injection of radioactive tracer and then have imaging scans taken about 2-3 hours later. The tracer accumulates in overactive parathyroid tissue, allowing your doctor to pinpoint exactly where the problem is. This information guides treatment decisions, whether medical or surgical. The procedure is painless, safe, and you'll go home the same day.
